[FACT] User has a farm.

[CHANGE] User has noticed an improvement in the quality of eggs from their chickens after using organic scratch grains.  
[EVENT] User has questions about cottage food laws regarding selling jams and honey.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant explained that food safety certification is recommended but not always required by law for cottage food operations.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided information on registration requirements for selling jams and honey at the farmer's market, noting that it may involve an initial registration and possible renewal.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant detailed labeling requirements for jams and honey, including the need for an ingredient list and allergen warning for jams, and net quantity and product name for honey.
